name: Emoji Picker
description: macOS-style emoji picker. Super+. (or Ctrl+Super+Space) opens it near the text cursor when the shell knows it, else centred on the focused window's monitor. Arrows move, Enter inserts, 1-9 pick from the highlighted row, typing searches (English and Chinese keywords), Tab / Ctrl+Left/Right switch category, Esc closes. The emoji is pasted into the previously focused app through the clipboard and a synthesized Ctrl+V (Ctrl+Shift+V in terminals); the old clipboard is restored afterwards.
